caption: The drawing depicts a single, blue glass pitcher situated centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher has a bulbous lower body with gentle swirling patterns, a narrow neck with two horizontal bands, and a slightly flared spout. The handle is thick, arching from the upper neck to the lower body, with a decorative loop near the attachment at the bottom. The blue color of the pitcher varies in intensity, suggesting transparency and reflective highlights. The overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the pitcher, which is rendered with careful detailing of light and shadow to convey its three-dimensional glass form. There is a thin rectangular border surrounding the pitcher, and the name "SHAREN ALVIN" is written in pencil in the bottom left corner inside the border.
title: Blown Glass - Pitcher
